ifc43-map-conversion.definition: a scaling of the three axes (x,y,z), by the same IfcMapConversion.Scale, followed by an anti-clockwise rotation about the z-axis of θ, where θ = arctan(XAxisOrdinate / XAxisAbscissa), and then a translation in (x,y,z) of IfcMapConversion.Eastings, IfcMapConversion.Northings, IfcMapConversion.OrthogonalHeight
ifc43-map-conversion.xAxisAbscissa: Specifies the value along the easting axis of the end point of a vector indicating the position of the local x axis of the engineering coordinate reference system.
ifc43-map-conversion.xAxisOrdinate: Specifies the value along the northing axis of the end point of a vector indicating the position of the local x axis of the engineering coordinate reference system.
ifc43-map-conversion.scale: If omitted, the value of 1.0 is assumed.
